prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. Reference is edit target. Photorealistic premium industrial-design concept of the same white trackpad in the reference. Important revision: visibly THINNER than reference, target concept envelope 160mm wide by115mm deep, front lip1.8mm rear6.5mm, gently tapered WEDGE with front thin/rear thick, NOT uniformly thick. Preserve the recognisable clean Apple Magic Trackpad-like plan proportions. Main surface plain flat warm-white glass, no dot matrix or ripples. Eight flush, physically depressible piano-action white keys incorporated inside the EXISTING rear18mm of the footprint, no added strip outside original footprint. Keys extend all the way to FREE rear outer edge, NO wraparound aluminium frame/metal rim, no chrome border enclosing keys or main glass. A completely recessed structural base can be hidden beneath white top. At rest keytops coplanar with main touch plane, key seams barely visible white-on-white; absolutely no raised tiled rounded keycaps or black trenches. Keep glyph order left to right: screenshot, drag hand, play/pause, speaker, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. Up/down soft ice blue #319eff; left/right mint #03bba9, other glyphs fine pearl grey. Restrained light emerging immediately underneath glyphs. Soft neutral warm-grey studio desk/daylight, expensive quiet product photography. No logo, text, labels, watermark, other devices or extra decorative items. This is a physical hardware concept, not software interface. Produce ONE landscape clean hero photograph from a LOW front-right three-quarter view that clearly shows the thin front lip and side rising only gently to the rear, while keeping entire object in frame. Remove the pointing finger from reference entirely. Empty calm product-only composition; main device dominates frame, no hand, no collage or inset. White top flows smoothly to edge, extremely delicate contact shadow; do not exaggerate rear height.
